claims.text: DeepSeek json_object mode requires the literal word "json" AND an example of the desired shape in the prompt; both are present here.
claims.why: The comment makes a claim about DeepSeek's requirements; this chunk does not contain evidence of that requirement. The function does include 'json' and an example, so the claim is plausible but not verifiable from this code alone.

claims.text: You are READ-ONLY: you cannot edit files or run tests, so files_changed and tests_run must be [].
claims.why: The prompt string in report_instructions contains this instruction.

claims.text: Return ONLY a json object with exactly these keys: status (done|blocked|needs_review|failed), summary (<=... chars), files_changed (array), tests_run (array), risks (array), todos (array), handoff (object).
claims.why: The function returns this exact instruction string.

claims.text: A billable provider must reserve BEFORE it calls out, and must turn a refusal into a valid agent_report_v1 rather than an exception, so a capped run still produces a report the harness can read instead of a stack trace the watcher swallows.
claims.why: Refers to agent_report_v1 and harness/watcher behavior outside this chunk. The functions budget_refusal_report and reserve_or_report exist but their full implementation is not present.

claims.text: The two helpers below are the whole integration surface; see daedalus/budget.py for why enforcement cannot live in one place.
claims.why: References daedalus/budget.py which is not in this chunk. The helpers are partially defined (reserve_or_report is incomplete).

claims.text: The blocked report for a refused call. NAMES the numbers.
claims.why: The function returns a blocked report that includes budget detail in handoff, thus naming the numbers.

claims.text: A refusal the operator cannot read is a refusal the operator switches off, so the ceiling, the spend and the refused label all survive into the report body and into handoff in machine-readable form.
claims.why: The function returns a report with status 'blocked', summary containing the exception, and handoff containing budget detail.

claims.text: Fill any missing report keys with safe defaults, then validate.
